title: Microsoft's ML for Beginners offers a 12-week practical curriculum
friendlyTitle: A free Microsoft course teaches machine learning from the start
summary: Microsoft's open machine-learning course contains 26 lessons and 52 quizzes covering regression, classification, clustering, natural-language processing, time series, reinforcement learning and real-world applications. The long-running repository has about 90,000 stars and remains actively maintained.
friendlySummary: This popular course has 26 lessons, quizzes and practical examples about the main ideas behind machine learning.
whyItMatters: Learners can follow the curriculum as a structured foundation beneath today's generative-AI tools, using notebooks and projects to understand how models are trained and evaluated. Teams can also adapt individual lessons for internal learning sessions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It gives beginners a clear learning path and helps AI users understand what is happening behind modern tools.
